item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of accountability, apologies, inquiries, prosecutions, or admissions of fault by Abiy or his government. I found no reliable public source showing Abiy accepted responsibility for the Merawi killings, drone strike harm, attacks on medical care, or attacks on aid workers. I also found no public correction from Abiy that his earlier security justifications were contradicted by later evidence.
